items.title: 第 1 题 · 重量不属于显示器的主要技术指标
items.style: 科技规格卡风，深灰底，青色描边，屏幕与量具元素
items.layout: A＝显示器体检表｜B＝六项指标清单｜C＝重量被划出｜D＝结论条
items.prompt: Tech spec-card infographic, landscape, four-zone layout, dark charcoal background, cyan outlines with soft glow, screen and measuring-tool elements. Zone A (left, about 60% width): a display service bench where a large monitor stands on a mat being checked; a technician in a lab coat holds a clipboard with a checklist and ticks items one by one; beside the monitor lie a pixel-grid card, a magnifier, a stopwatch, a colour wheel and a long tape measure; on the far right of the bench stands a heavy platform scale with a small plug icon above it, and the technician's pen marks that line out; the monitor is highlighted. Zone B (upper right): a monitor drawn in line art with a checklist panel beside it; the panel holds six row icons (a pixel grid, a dot-gauge, a width ruler, a refresh arrow, a colour wheel and a weighing scale); five rows carry a green tick and the weighing-scale row carries a red cross with a horizontal line through it; dotted leaders connect each row to its part of the monitor. Zone C (lower right): a pale card with three rows of small tags, each row ticked instead of crossed — a resolution grid, a dot gauge and a size ruler. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a dark rounded conclusion strip with a cyan check badge. Text on the image is Simplified Chinese only, in four short labels: "分辨率", "点距尺寸", "重量", "不是指标" — bold sans-serif on small dark rounded plates, each label no more than four characters. 16:9 landscape, high resolution, clean background.

items.title: 第 2 题 · 任何计算机病毒都有清除的办法
items.style: 扁平轻幽默插画，暖橙底，深棕粗线条，带一点卡通感
items.layout: A＝维修工清理故障机器 / B＝清除手段四条 / C＝三种说法划叉 / D＝结论条
items.prompt: Flat humorous illustration, landscape, four-zone layout, warm orange background, dark brown thick outlines, light cartoon feel, reassuring mood. Zone A (left, about 60% width): a repair workshop where a technician in overalls cleans a sick desktop computer — the tower sits on a bench with its side panel off, small spiky virus creatures being swept out with a small broom; the technician holds a spray bottle labelled with a shield icon in one hand and a screwdriver in the other; shelves behind hold a rescue disc, a back-up drive and a system reinstall box; a first-aid cross sign and a stool complete the scene; a clean, glowing computer sits ready on the output side. Zone B (upper right): a four-step rescue chain drawn as a ladder of plates — a scanning lens, a broom, a back-up drive and a fresh install disc — with an upward arrow running through all four; a small badge at the top shows a clean healthy machine; each plate carries a tiny label; a note tag beside the chain reads as "there is always a way". Zone C (lower right): a pale card with three rows of small tags, each row struck through with a thin grey line — a sealed software box with a crack, an optical disc, and a document sheet. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a warm rounded conclusion strip with a green check badge. Text on the image is Simplified Chinese only, in four short labels: "正版也会中毒", "光盘会带毒", "文档会带毒", "总能清除" — bold brown rounded type on white rounded plates; the longest label is six characters. 16:9 landscape, high resolution, clean background.
